subject: Explainable routing kickoff: 'why is my route different today?'
body:
Team,

Kicking off the explainable-routing effort. Our open-source release implements the "Why is My Route Different Today?" algorithm, generating explanations for route selection over a collection of synthetically-generated traffic scenarios on OSM-derived graphs - the release ships processed Baden and Washington region graphs. Mapping and logistics partners keep telling us the same thing: users don't distrust reroutes because they're wrong, they distrust them because they're unexplained.

Deliverable: an explanation service over our internal routing testbed, with quality evaluation on both released regions plus one partner-shaped scenario set.

Milestones for Apr 6 - Jul 6: C++ build productionized (it's currently a CMake/Abseil research build with hand-run steps) and scenarios reproducing by May 1, explanation-quality eval framework by May 29, partner demo with the plotly-based visualizations replaced by a real front end by Jun 26.

Daniela owns staffing.

Anders
